args.question: I found the cheapest nonstop SFO→JFK flight on 2026-11-12 (F100, $289). However, I have no record of Dana Lee's past reservations, so I can't determine her "usual hotel" in New York. The available New York hotels for 2026-11-12 for 2 nights are: Midtown Lodge ($378 total), Harbor Inn ($478 total), Plaza Grand ($918 total). Which one is Dana's usual hotel? (Note: choosing Plaza Grand would bring the trip total to $1207, which exceeds $1000 and would require manager approval.)
